about: Big fish placed by the scheduler rules for waves 8-16. Each entry: fish, route id (see fish/), start and end second, optional lane height, mirror flags (mx left-right, my top-bottom, rev backwards) and tag. Mediums are filled in by tools/sketch_waves.py using laws/laws.json.

waves.title: Manta first, then a curious Shark
waves.story: The Manta glides the top row with its followers while the Hammerhead patrols the bottom seats. The Shark waits until the Manta is gone, then drops in from the top, inspects a bottom seat and climbs back out.
snaps: Curious Shark dips to a seat

waves.title: The Shark cuts a diagonal
waves.story: A Marlin opens the wave with a fast dash. The Shark comes in from the bottom-left corner and climbs to the top-right, so the mediums split to the two corners it leaves open. After it passes, the Hammerhead turns down the right side and a second Marlin slashes through a Sardine school.

waves.title: Meeting: Shark and Manta
waves.story: Meeting wave. The Manta glides the bottom seat row right to left. The Shark gate only allows a calm lane far from it, so the Shark cruises the top row, entering from the edge farthest from the Manta. Mediums stay in the middle band between the two. No Hammerhead or Marlin during the meeting.

waves.title: An aggressive Charge
waves.story: Short and sharp. A Marlin hooks in and out, then an aggressive Shark charges straight across the middle, right to left, in seven seconds. The Hammerhead follows by sweeping the top row.

waves.title: Feeding circle, then the Manta
waves.story: A hungry Shark comes in from the right and circles on the right side. The Hammerhead keeps to the left with a side swing. Once the Shark leaves, a Marlin dashes through and the Manta glides corner to corner with its followers.

waves.title: Two Sharks
waves.story: Rare double. The Shark patrols the left side and a smaller Shark shadows it 2.5 seconds behind in the same lane. The right half belongs to the mediums. Once both Sharks leave, two Hammerheads patrol the top and bottom seat rows, mirrored.
snaps: Shark and its Shadow loop the left

waves.title: Manta loop, then a Stalker
waves.story: The Manta circles on the left side while the Hammerhead runs the top seats the other way. When the Manta leaves, a Marlin dashes through, then a curious Shark stalks slowly from right to left through the lower middle.
snaps: Manta loops left, Hammerhead on top

waves.title: The Shark splits the screen
waves.story: The Shark drops straight down the middle. Nothing crosses the center while it is there: each half gets its own fish that come in and leave on the same side. A Marlin crosses 4 seconds after the Shark is gone.
snaps: Shark splits, each half on its own

waves.title: Meeting: the Shark has to wait
waves.story: Meeting wave on a Grand arc. The Manta covers most of the screen, so no Shark lane fits and the Shark waits off screen. It enters at 31 s along the top row once the Manta has passed. This happens about once every 36 waves.
snaps: Grand arc, Shark waits off screen
